name: zone-arc
title: Zone Arc
description: A reading on a half dial of coloured zones: zones sweep in, a marker swings over and its zone lights up.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas. The sweep and marker run on the UI thread on arrival and on change. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The dial appears whole, the marker jumps to its place and the number does not count.
a11y.screenReader: One label ("86 AQI, zone 2 of 4, 4 min ago").
